menu.$description: DropdownMenu, ContextMenu and Menubar — one menu anatomy shared by the three. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

border.$description: A real border, not a box-shadow ring: forced-colors mode strips every shadow, and a menu with no edge is Canvas on Canvas there.

item-height.$description: Minimum item height, one step under the control height so a menu stays denser than the form it sits over: 28px at default density (unchanged from the fixed padding it replaces), 32px comfortable, 24px compact — still the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target.

item-corner.$description: Concentric with the popup: the overlay corner minus the popup's 4px inset.

item-danger-highlight.$description: Highlight behind a destructive item. Derived over the menu surface rather than borrowed from feedback.error-subtle, which is built for surface.default and nearly vanishes on the overlay surface (1.07:1 in light). text.danger holds ≥4.9:1 on it in both themes.
